stories.title: Texas halts new data center grid connections amid demand surge
stories.summary: Texas has stopped connecting new data centers to its power grid as electricity demand from data center growth has surged, with the state citing figures over 400 gigawatts of requested capacity. The governor has ordered audits of new data center projects in response. Multiple outlets reported the halt and audit order on the same day.
stories.whyItMatters: AI-driven data center buildout is now running into hard grid-capacity limits in a major hub state, a bottleneck that could slow infrastructure expansion for cloud and AI companies nationally.
whatToWatch: Results of the governor-ordered audit of new data centers
Whether other states impose similar grid-connection pauses
How affected companies respond to delayed connections
questions: How long is the connection halt expected to last?
Which companies' projects are most affected by the pause?

stories.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken trade secrets to OpenAI
stories.summary: Apple has broadened claims in its trade secrets lawsuit, saying additional former employees may have carried confidential information to OpenAI. OpenAI pushed back, calling the suit 'aggressive and oddly personal.' The dispute continues to escalate between the two AI competitors.
stories.whyItMatters: A widening trade-secrets fight between Apple and OpenAI could shape hiring norms and competitive tension across the AI industry.
